title: Nehemiah: 'The Joy of Jehovah Is Your Stronghold'
original_title: Nehemiah: 'The Joy of Jehovah Is Your Stronghold'
overview: Nehemiah leaves his position in the Castle of Shushan to rebuild the walls of Jehovah's great city. However, a large construction project isn't the only test he will face. Will prayer and courage be enough to complete the project? How would Jehovah teach his people what true joy is?
